A '''bacta grenade''' was a long-range healing device that contained [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], a type of synthetic healing fluid, which would be released when the [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] was activated and thrown. During combat, [[Medic/Legends|medics]] would throw the grenades near injured individuals who were out of reach of more conventional forms of healing. The grenades were made up of two halves that would separate in order for the bacta to spray out from the inside. One type of bacta grenade had [[Color/Legends|gray]] halves, a red button on the top of one half, and a red light on the side of each half. Bacta grenades were used by medics serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWGTCG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], bacta grenades were also used by Imperial and neutral medics.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}
[[Bacta bomb/Legends|Bacta bombs]] were larger, more powerful versions of the bacta grenade that were used around the same [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bacta grenade first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment,<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> They were added to the game in the [[2005]] New Game Enhancements as a long-range healing ability for the medic class.<ref name="SWG" /> In [[2008]], the bacta grenade received a card in [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']], the first set of cards produced for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'', which was a virtual card game produced by Sony to go along with ''Star War Galaxies''. The bacta-grenade card was illustrated by the artist [[Kieran Yanner]].<ref name="SWGTCG" /> The bacta-grenade card was given to the Rebel faction in the trading-card game, while in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', any character who was a medic could use bacta grenades.<ref name="SWG" />
